claims.claim: MFW, BRICS+ Fashion Summit and Made in Moscow are connected by one platform shell.
The shared shell maintains one profile with event-scoped MFW/BFS registrations and separate Made in Moscow brand verification.
Discover and agenda can span MFW and BFS; Made brands appear only from the verified roster authority.
Deal Room lifecycle is represented as a read-only product contract preview.
Trust Passport is an explainable read-only preview without a universal reputation score.
Five monetisation surfaces and evidence gates are represented without claiming realised ARR/MRR.
Remote public media is source-owned and is not treated as a commercial-use licence.
This investor UI wave does not itself prove production PostgreSQL readiness.
One platform subject is projected across MFW, BFS and Made in Moscow while event registrations, credentials and Made brand verification remain scoped.
The investor MVP exposes a nine-stage evidence chain with separate live and synthetic modes.
Partner/Sponsor Console maps package through settlement and keeps recognised revenue behind evidence gates.
Brand Cockpit maps exposure through commercial outcome and shows D30/D90/D365 continuity.
Economics maps payer, product, formula and revenue-recognition gate without factual ARR/MRR placeholders.
Investor Proof is implemented as an Evidence Control Tower with Case Dossier and Portfolio View.
Synthetic investor dossiers expose source, viewed/saved signals, recommendation reason, meeting, intent, Deal Room, handoff, D30/D90/D365, evidence class/reference and potential revenue surfaces.
Synthetic portfolio aggregates Audience → Engagement → Qualified Buyer → Meeting → Intent → Deal → Retention → Revenue Evidence while retaining explicit synthetic labelling.

rules: No meeting or request is counted as revenue.
Observed, reported, verified, modelled and synthetic evidence remain distinct.
Synthetic demo cases are not production KPI evidence.

controlTower.boundary: Portfolio counts and dossier scenarios are illustrative/synthetic unless separately evidenced by production authority.
